article.headline: Los Angeles faces Utah after Grimes' 47-point game
article.description: Utah Jazz (1-13, 14th in the Western Conference) vs. Los Angeles Lakers (13-2, first in the Western Conference)
article.title: Los Angeles faces Utah after Grimes' 47-point game
article.linkText: Los Angeles faces Utah after Grimes' 47-point game
article.story: Utah Jazz (1-13, 14th in the Western Conference) vs. Los Angeles Lakers (13-2, first in the Western Conference) Los Angeles; Wednesday, 10 p.m. EST LINE: Lakers -10.5; over/under is 229.5 BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles faces the Utah Jazz after Quentin Grimes scored 47 points in the Los Angeles Lakers' 118-114 overtime victory over the Charlotte Hornets. The Lakers are 7-2 in Western Conference games. Los Angeles is seventh in the Western Conference with 48.3 points per game in the paint led by Walker Kessler averaging 12.1. The Jazz are 2-11 against Western Conference opponents. Utah averages 15.8 turnovers per game and is 0-2 when turning the ball over less than opponents. The Lakers average 14.5 made 3-pointers per game this season, 2.0 more made shots on average than the 12.5 per game the Jazz allow. The Lakers average 108.7 points per game, 6.1 fewer points than the 114.8 the Lakers give up to opponents. The teams play for the second time this season. The Lakers won the last meeting 132-123 on Oct. 25, with Luka Doncic scoring 52 points in the victory. TOP PERFORMERS: Matisse Thybulle is scoring 7.4 points per game and averaging 2.3 rebounds for the Lakers. Doncic is averaging 32.4 points and 5.9 rebounds over the last 10 games. Keyonte George is scoring 20.3 points per game and averaging 4.5 rebounds for the Jazz. Darryn Peterson is averaging 2.5 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Lakers: 9-1, averaging 122.1 points, 43.1 rebounds, 24.7 assists, 10.8 steals and 6.3 blocks per game while shooting 48.1% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 115.4 points per game. Jazz: 0-9, averaging 106.9 points, 43.1 rebounds, 23.9 assists, 7.6 steals and 5.6 blocks per game while shooting 44.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 115.8 points. INJURIES: Lakers: Austin Reaves: out (heel), Walker Kessler: out (leg). Jazz: Lauri Markkanen: out (wrist), Jaxson Hayes: out (knee), Jusuf Nurkic: out (foot), Jaren Jackson Jr.: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
